question:
**Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A medicine or other substance that has a calming or soothing effect.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sedative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sedative"** refers to a medicine or substance that helps to calm or soothe the nerves or induces sleep. (शांत करने वाली दवा)
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed a sedative to help the patient sleep peacefully at night.
 
 
• **"Stimulant"** refers to a substance that increases activity in the body or mind, often the opposite of sedative. (उत्तेजक)
 
 
• **Example:** Coffee acts as a stimulant, keeping people awake and alert.
 
 
• Hence, the correct word is **"Sedative"**, which has a calming effect. (शांत प्रभाव)
 
 
• **Example:** After the stressful event, the patient was given a mild sedative to relax.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sedative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stimulant** (उत्तेजक): A substance that increases physiological or nervous activity in the body.
 
 
• **Example:** Drinking tea can act as a mild stimulant to improve focus.
 
 
 
• **Analgesic** (दर्द निवारक): A medicine used to relieve pain.
 
 
• **Example:** Paracetamol is an effective analgesic for headaches.
 
 
 
• **Antibiotic** (प्रतिजैविक): A substance used to treat bacterial infections.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the bacterial infection.
